tp_slicing_math.qkv: original weight [3456,1152] is three 1152-row q/k/v segments; rank r takes rows [s*1152+r*144, s*1152+(r+1)*144] for s in {q,k,v} and concatenates to 432 = 3*2*72; bias sliced identically
tp_slicing_math.local_heads: each rank owns heads 2r,2r+1; qkv.reshape(seq,3,2,72) reproduces head order (2r,2r+1) inside each segment because 144 = 2*72
tp_slicing_math.out_proj: attn_output.transpose(1,2).reshape(seq,144) produces row t = [head 2r 72 | head 2r+1 72], exactly global columns r*144:(r+1)*144, matching the proj weight column shard
tp_slicing_math.mlp: 4304 = 8*538 exactly; fc1 output rows r*538:(r+1)*538, fc2 input columns r*538:(r+1)*538, original nn.GELU(approximate='tanh') applied to exactly the 538 logical channels (elementwise, so channel splitting is exact)
tp_slicing_math.attention: unmasked, non-causal, original scale 72**-0.5, original cu_seqlens split into two 4032-token images, original Float rotary helper reused unmodified
tp_slicing_math.collective: row-mode partials stay Float32 into group.all_reduce; the original Half bias is widened to Float32 and added once AFTER the collective; exactly one Half cast at the end; column-mode qkv/fc1 add the exact original Half bias widened to Float inside the kernel and cast once to Half

gate_integrity.detail: expected_vision107.json is derived from the real R107 vision_tp01 receipts (all 4 case merged SHAs match the R107 rank0 receipt exactly). R108 then requires its own vision merged/27-boundary/DeepStack SHAs to equal that R107 identity, which proves cross-run bitwise determinism rather than correctness by construction. Correctness of the TP path is independently anchored by (a) the head2 probe's bit-equality against the 16-head BC128 head slices whose CPU error was measured, and (b) the whole-vision CPU FP16 merger RMS 0.698518% in R107.

findings.title: Local mirrored capture set is still filling; every file must pass its receipt SHA before the set is called complete
evidence: observed at review time: native SHA_OK (20,941,151 B), corrected_vision_native_text SHA_OK (20,941,413 B), corrected_replica_BC128_native_text completed during the review and now SHA_OK (20,941,604 B)

corrected_VisionTP8_native_text was mid-copy (17,756,160 B and growing, not yet equal to its receipt file_SHA256 121c958b94683b11...), and corrected_VisionTP8_precise_text (receipt file_SHA256 c284cc4d55440fcf...) was not present yet
a complete Half selected50 payload is 2043*5120*2 = 20,920,320 bytes, so any smaller file is necessarily a truncated copy
the mirror is actively being populated by the root between observations, so this is an in-progress state rather than a corrupt source
findings.impact: The REMOTE evidence is intact: final_source_verification_grid_fixed108.json already verified all 5 remote files (Half dtype, correct tensor SHA, captured_outside_warm_clock_not_used_as_input=true). The risk is local only. If the remote /tmp/h3_round108_full01 root is cleaned when the owned 910A lease is released, an incompletely mirrored TP8 capture (the most relevant one for future DiT-conditioning precision work) would be lost, and a partially copied file must never be treated as immutable.
findings.required_action: Finish mirroring all five NPU_selected50_*.pt files and enforce sha256 == receipt file_SHA256 per file before declaring the captured set complete or releasing/cleaning the remote root. Replace, never keep, any file that fails that check.

findings.title: Any '1.365 s' bound for the TP8 case would be knife-edge; the written evidence correctly uses <2 s and should keep doing so
evidence: the 8-rank-max samples for corrected_VisionTP8_native_text are 1.311685 / 1.243577 / 1.322445 / 1.364717 / 1.321200 s; the largest is 1.364717, only 0.000283 s below 1.365
grep over round107/round108 docs finds no written 1.365 claim; README states the samples and 'all <2 s', which is correct and has a 31.7% margin
findings.impact: None on the result. A bound picked just above the observed maximum is not a stable threshold and would be fragile if repeated as a settled property.
findings.required_action: Report the measured maximum (1.364717 s) or the <2 s target, and avoid restating a 1.365 s bound as if it were a design limit.

findings.title: README derives 'complete time reduced 38.73%' where the receipts give 38.724% -> 38.72%

findings.impact: Cosmetic 0.006 percentage-point discrepancy in a derived sentence; no metric is misstated materially.
findings.required_action: Use 38.72% or state the raw medians only.

findings.title: Backend and head2 engine express their contracts with bare assert statements
evidence: vision_gemm_backend107.py prime/pack_input/run use `assert` for dtype/shape/device/bias contracts
head2_attention107.py forward uses `assert` for shape/dtype/device and the score-bound domain
findings.impact: Under `python -O` those guards would be stripped and the backend could run on a mismatched dtype/shape instead of failing closed. The recorded runs were not invoked with -O, so no result is affected, and this mirrors the accepted style of earlier engines in this project.
findings.required_action: Optional hardening (explicit raises); not required to accept the current measurements.

findings.title: The TP vision accuracy improvement and the 0.835 s encoder saving are not attributable to head-sharding alone
evidence: TP vision CPU merger RMS is 0.698518% vs replicated BC128 0.728894%, but the TP path also changes the projection arithmetic to Float accumulation with Float bias and a single Half cast, so part of the accuracy change comes from precision, not from sharding

encoder-level TP delta is 2.156184 - 1.321200 = 0.834984 s while the vision-only R107 delta is 1.483958 - 0.675060 = 0.808898 s; about 0.026 s is unattributed (plausibly allocator/interaction noise, and the attention launch shape 16-head -> 2-head also changes)
both deltas point the same way and the per-case order control shows no drift, so this is not a fairness problem
findings.impact: None on the acceptance boundary; the documents already state the Float row-partial arithmetic. Only a reader might over-read 'TP is more accurate' as a sharding property.
findings.required_action: None mandatory; if the number is quoted, keep the arithmetic description attached.

claims_audit.documented_limitations_match_evidence: R107 README says 'not 8x' (2.198x vision vs replica, 2.032x vs corrected native attention, both recomputed and correct), and R108 README says the CPU precision gap is still 4.395% and not accepted; both match the raw receipts

blocking_for_any_future_acceptance: Full-graph relative RMS vs the original CPU FP16 oracle remains 4.395021% (native text) / 5.125418% (precise text); no threshold exists or may be invented after the fact
encoder/DiT/VAE co-residency is unmeasured: the 8.627 GiB end / 11.858 GiB diagnostic peak is a benchmark footprint including baselines and capture, explicitly not a service steady state
official matched-condition comparison (A2/A3 T2VA, BF16, other hardware) still does not apply to this FL2VA FP16 910A composition
